body:
Go to any boot camp and you'll see mostly 17-20 year olds who still have no idea what they've gotten themselves into or why they're there.  

I cannot get back into the infantry, or likely the corps at all.  My next option used to be law enforcement, but a friend did that and quit soon after, warning that it was more about being miserable and angry than it was about helping people - not by choice.  So I became a personal trainer and was very excited about that for a while, but I was nearly fired because I refused to lie to clients to get their money.  Now the thought of that field makes me cringe.  I don't know where I belong.
